name: Fuse Compressor

mac.holds: native presets; path not tested on this Windows installation

notes: VST3 only. The processor class ID was enumerated from the installed VST3 factory.
Kumi writes from a plug-in-generated initial VST3 state, retaining controller state and unknown data. No factory presets, sample libraries, or waveforms are bundled.
Full preset state is supported. Partial effect-node subpresets require their enclosing product state; mapped_value is authoritative on restore, not unmapped_value.
